title.zh: 当着所有人的面约定一个秘密
title.en: Agreeing on a Secret in Plain Sight

desc.zh: 两个陌生人在所有人都能偷听的线路上，怎么约定一个只有他俩知道的秘密？单向函数、Diffie–Hellman、RSA、椭圆曲线、证书链、量子威胁和格密码，每一步都在页面里用真实的算术跑一遍。
desc.en: How can two strangers agree on a secret over a line that everyone can listen to? One-way functions, Diffie–Hellman, RSA, elliptic curves, certificate chains, the quantum threat and lattice cryptography: each step runs real arithmetic on this page.
